import { Injectable, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { BullModule, InjectQueue, Processor, WorkerHost } from '@nestjs/bullmq';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Job, Queue } from 'bullmq';
import { Entity, PrimaryColumn, Repository } from 'typeorm';

@Entity('generated_pdf')
class GeneratedPdfEntity {
  @PrimaryColumn()
  declare id: string;
}

@Injectable()
class BranchingProducer {
  constructor(
    @InjectQueue('reports')
    private readonly reports: Queue<{ readonly id: string }, void, string>,
  ) {}

  // D0_CASE:bullmq-branch-generate-pdf
  async generate(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.reports.add('generate-pdf', { id });
  }

  // D0_CASE:bullmq-branch-cleanup
  async cleanup(id: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.reports.add('cleanup', { id });
  }
}

@Processor('reports')
class BranchingProcessor extends WorkerHost {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(GeneratedPdfEntity)
    private readonly generated: Repository<GeneratedPdfEntity>,
  ) {
    super();
  }

  async process(job: Job<{ readonly id: string }, unknown, string>): Promise<void> {
    switch (job.name) {
      case 'generate-pdf':
        await this.generated.save({ id: job.data.id });
        return;
      case 'cleanup':
        return;
      default:
        return;
    }
  }
}

@Module({
  imports: [BullModule.forRoot({}), BullModule.registerQueue({ name: 'reports' })],
  providers: [BranchingProducer, BranchingProcessor],
})
class BranchingWorkerModule {}

const __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__ = (() => {
  throw new Error('D0 BullMQ fixture must never execute: branch-filtering');
})();
void __D0_EXECUTION_SENTINEL__;
